Straight answers

Frequently asked questions

What is the PSSSB District Treasurer exam pattern?

Under the official Advt 13/2023 plan - 120 MCQs, 120 marks, 2 hours, on GK, Punjab history and culture, reasoning, Punjabi, English and ICT, with 1/4 mark cut for each wrong answer.

Is there an accounts or finance subject paper?

No. The 2023 plan is entirely general; it has no subject part.

When was it last advertised?

In PSSSB Advertisement No. 13 of 2023, the same advertisement that had Technical Assistant posts. Read the next advertisement for eligibility, pay and posts.
